identity.name: VnExpress
identity.description: Vietnam's leading online newspaper, publishing Vietnamese and English coverage of national politics, business, society and international affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Operated by FPT Online, a subsidiary of technology conglomerate FPT Group. Although commercially owned, Vietnamese media operate under party-state oversight and licensing.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Commercial ownership sits within Vietnam's one-party media system; coverage generally follows official policy boundaries and avoids systemic criticism.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via secondary references (official about page blocked or unavailable); secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No independent rating; the outlet operates under party-state media guidance, so its political framing is treated as state-aligned.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage emphasises national development and official policy priorities within a socialist-market framework.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Vietnamese national lens aligned with party-state foreign and development policy.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Professional online newsroom with broad reporting, but structural constraints limit adversarial verification of state claims.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified for VnExpress.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Vietnamese national coverage with a development and official-policy lens, useful for understanding the country's business and social agenda.

selectionRationale: Adds Vietnamese national coverage from the country's leading online outlet, balancing regional English-language sources.

research.researchNotes: Official About page returned 406. Ownership from FPT and Wikipedia. State-aligned assessment reflects Vietnam's media system, not direct state ownership. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
